name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport catering wasn't planned. Initially working in fine dining restaurants across Lisbon, he stumbled upon an opportunity to cater for a small racing team during a local rally event. The fast-paced environment and passionate atmosphere hooked him instantly. He quickly adapted his culinary skills to meet the unique needs of a motorsport team, focusing on providing nutritious, high-energy meals that can be prepared and served efficiently under demanding conditions.

Ricardo excels at managing catering operations, ensuring that all team members and guests are well-fed and energized throughout race weekends. He is known for his calm and collected demeanor, even when faced with logistical challenges or unexpected dietary requirements. Ricardo prides himself on creating a positive and supportive environment within the catering team, fostering a strong work ethic and a commitment to quality. His innovative approach to menu planning, incorporating local ingredients and modern culinary techniques, sets him apart in the paddock. He believes a well-fed team is a winning team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with a kind face and a warm smile that suggests he knows a good joke.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and menu ideas
Meticulously organizes the pantry by ingredient type and expiration date
Refuses to start cooking without first listening to a specific Portuguese fado song
